title: Pyne Pod Blueberry Raspberry Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Blueberry Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid provides a perfectly balanced, all-day fruit profile. The experience begins with the smooth, earthy sweetness of dark Blueberry, creating a rich and satisfying inhale. A bright, tart layer of fresh Raspberry follows closely behind, lifting the profile with a sharp and mouth-watering finish. This contrasting berry combination delivers a consistently vibrant taste that never becomes overly sweet. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the classic berry medley of Blueberry Raspberry, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the sparkling notes of Fizzy Cherry, the botanical purity of Fresh Mint, or the tropical warmth of Frozen Peach.
